email.common.link_fallback: If the button doesn't work, copy and paste this link into your browser:
email.login.subject: Your sign-in code for {{app_name}}
email.login.heading: Your sign-in code
email.login.body: Enter this code to sign in to {{app_name}}. It expires in {{expires_in}} minutes.
email.login.footer: If you didn't try to sign in, you can safely ignore this email.
email.password_reset.subject: Reset your {{app_name}} password
email.password_reset.heading: Reset your password
email.password_reset.body: Enter this code to choose a new password. It expires in {{expires_in}} minutes.
email.password_reset.footer: If you didn't ask to reset your password, you can safely ignore this email.
email.email_verification.subject: Verify your email for {{app_name}}
email.email_verification.heading: Verify your email
email.email_verification.body: Enter this code to verify your email address. It expires in {{expires_in}} minutes.
email.email_verification.footer: If you didn't request this, you can safely ignore this email.
email.mfa.subject: Your verification code for {{app_name}}
email.mfa.heading: Your verification code
email.mfa.body: Enter this code to confirm it's you. It expires in {{expires_in}} minutes.
email.mfa.footer: If you didn't try to sign in, someone may know your password: change it.
sms.mfa: %[1]s is your %[2]s verification code. Don't share it with anyone.
sms.phone_verification: %[1]s is your %[2]s code to confirm this phone number.
sms.test: Test message from %[1]s: SMS delivery works.
email.invitation.subject: You're invited to join {{organization}}
email.invitation.heading: Join {{organization}}
email.invitation.body:
{{inviter}} invited you to join {{organization}} on {{app_name}}.

This invitation expires on {{expires_at}}.
email.invitation.footer: If you weren't expecting this invitation, you can ignore this email.
email.test.subject: Test email from {{app_name}}
email.test.heading: Email delivery works
email.test.body: This test message confirms that {{app_name}} can send email. No action is needed.
email.test.footer: You received this because someone tested email delivery for {{app_name}}.
